summary: Implemented the Seeker preferences, personal information, and account settings screens using the existing /api/v1/me and /api/v1/me/preferences contracts. Added strict client validation, authenticated loading and mutation adapters, safe unavailable states for unsupported account operations, Arabic/English/Simplified Chinese copy and direction handling, keyboard-safe navigation, regression tests, and desktop visual baselines.

verification.notes: Contracts build and Web TypeScript typecheck passed.
Web source, tests, Playwright configuration, and server lint passed with zero warnings.
Focused profile test file passed 7 tests, including contract-shaped API requests, validation, locale direction, retry, and anonymous permission behavior.
Full Web test gate passed: 23 Vitest files with 149 tests and 76 Node/TAP tests.
Client and SSR Web builds passed. Vite emitted only its existing chunk-size advisory.
Created the nine approved desktop visual baselines across Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR; all 9 journeys passed.
Regression browser run passed 9/9 profile, preferences, settings, save, focus, safe-projection, and denied-session journeys.
Inventory contains GET/PATCH /api/v1/me and GET/PATCH /api/v1/me/preferences as implemented operations.
Agent Pack audit returned zero errors before task closure.

sourceEvidence: packages/contracts/src/seeker/index.ts: strict seeker profile and preferences request/response schemas
apps/web/src/features/seeker/profile.tsx and apps/web/src/features/seeker/data.ts: runtime UI and contract adapters
apps/web/tests/seeker-profile.vitest.test.tsx and apps/web/tests/e2e/seeker-profile.spec.ts: component, contract, ownership-safe projection, locale, focus, visual, and permission evidence
scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified as an explicitly necessary integration exception to route /seeker/profile and /seeker/settings to the selected feature.

The current runtime has no approved password/security, session-management, notification-settings, or account-deletion contracts; Account Settings therefore exposes truthful unavailable or disabled states and only uses implemented profile locale and logout behavior.
knownGaps: Unsupported account operations remain unavailable until their backend contracts are approved and implemented.
